adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a deliberate API contract change in `Admin::GroupsController#create`: it now reads `params[:name]`/`params[:visible]` (flat params) and no longer reads `params[:group][:name]`/`params[:group][:usernames]` (old envelope) (see `def create` in `app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb`). The JS client was updated to match (`Group.asJSON()` now returns flat keys and `Group.create()` posts them), and tests were updated accordingly. So nothing in-repo is broken, but older clients still sending `group: { name, usernames, visible }` would indeed result in `name` becoming `''` and likely a validation failure, and atomic create+members is removed in favor of `add_members`/`remove_member` endpoints.
